content.title: Module 2
content.subtitle: Energy Access and Inclusive Energy Services
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the third chapter of the Just Energy Transition Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Just Energy Transition
nextBlock.cta: Module 3 explores the Just Energy Transition, emphasizing equity, justice, and inclusion in the shift to sustainable energy.
